comparison.objective: Release a game disc from its case hub and insert it upright into a console slot.
comparison.physical_skill: Press a release while edge-grasping a thin disc, reorient it, and perform narrow slot insertion.
comparison.success_condition: The drive takes the correctly aligned disc; drops zero the trial and partial credit covers release or shallow insertion.
comparison.reason: Press-to-release extraction and thin-object insertion do not test setting or locking an adjustable stop.
